EdwCustomTableConfig.CreateViewQuery:
CREATE VIEW [Organization].[vw_CUS__Date] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS SELECT Date, Year, Month, Day, Quarter, MonthName, DayName, DayOfWeek, Week FROM dbo.DateTable('1994-01-01', DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy, 0, GETDATE()) + 5, -1) )
